MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 9

2. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 6

3. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

4. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

8. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 56

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

12. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
